title: Only registered pest-control products may be recommended in Kenya
farmerLine: Kenyan crop-protection advice has to match a current PCPB registered use and the product label. Ask Mkulima will not name a spray, rate or chemical from memory.
farmerLineSw: Ushauri wa kulinda mazao nchini Kenya unafaa kufuata matumizi yaliyosajiliwa na PCPB na lebo ya bidhaa. Uliza Mkulima hatataja dawa, kiasi, wala kemikali kutoka kumbukumbu.
body: The Pest Control Products Board publishes registered pest-control products and registered uses in Kenya. A chat answer must not invent a pesticide. Confirm the crop, pest, registration number and the approved label, including any re-entry or pre-harvest interval, with an extension officer or agrovet.

title: Plant maize after the soil has received moisture, not from a forecast alone
farmerLine: Kenyan maize guidance is to confirm that the topsoil is moist enough before planting. A rain forecast is not enough on its own.
farmerLineSw: Ushauri wa mahindi nchini Kenya ni kuthibitisha udongo wa juu umepata unyevu wa kutosha kabla ya kupanda. Utabiri wa mvua peke yake hautoshi.
body: Location-specific maize advice in Kenya combines rainfall, soil and crop stage. Farmers should walk the field and check that the seedbed has received enough moisture. A phone forecast can change and does not replace what the soil is doing.

title: Fall armyworm needs scouting; one symptom is not a confirmed diagnosis
farmerLine: Windowed leaves, frass in the funnel or chewed whorls can match fall armyworm and other pests. Scout several plants. Do not spray from a photo or a chat guess.
farmerLineSw: Majani yenye madirisha, kinyesi kwenye funeli, au vichipukizi vilivyotafunwa vinaweza kufanana na fall armyworm au wadudu wengine. Kagua mimea kadhaa. Usinyunyizie kutokana na picha au dhana ya gumzo.
body: Plantwise-style diagnosis uses several plant parts and field history, not a single symptom. For maize, check the funnel, leaf windows and nearby plants. Management must follow a current Kenyan registered product if a chemical is considered. Ask Mkulima may help you look and locate help. It must not name a spray programme.

title: Serious livestock illness needs a veterinary officer, not a chat dose
farmerLine: If an animal is off feed, suddenly weak, or in pain, contact a veterinary officer. Ask Mkulima will not give a medicine name or a dose.
farmerLineSw: Mnyama akiacha kula, akiwa dhaifu ghafla, au akiuma, wasiliana na daktari wa mifugo. Uliza Mkulima hatatoa jina la dawa wala kipimo.
body: Quality preventive livestock care depends on access to veterinary and paraprofessional services. A phone assistant can help you notice warning signs and find a listed service near the farm. It must not replace a veterinarian or invent an antibiotic, wormer or injection.

title: KAMIS figures are latest reported market prices, not a live shop offer
farmerLine: A Ministry reported price is what was last published for that market and crop. It is not what your buyer or agrovet must charge today.
farmerLineSw: Bei ya Wizara iliyoripotiwa ni ile iliyochapishwa mwisho kwa soko na zao hilo. Si lazima ndiyo mnunuzi au agrovet atakayotoza leo.
body: Kenya's Agricultural Market Information System publishes commodity prices by market. Use them as a reference from the farm place. Confirm grade, quantity and the actual offer at the market. Transport cost is usually missing, so a higher distant price may not leave more net income.

title: Daily milk records stay farmer-reported until a visit confirms them
farmerLine: Morning and evening litres should be saved with the date. Added by you is not the same as checked during a farm visit.
farmerLineSw: Lita za asubuhi na jioni zihifadhiwe pamoja na tarehe. Umeongeza wewe si sawa na kukaguliwa wakati wa tembeleo la shamba.
body: Dairy decisions get better when morning and evening yields are written down. Ask Mkulima may draft a record from a conversation. It must wait for you to confirm before anything is saved. A later MkulimaCollect count can disagree with a self-reported herd size; both claims should stay visible.

title: Do not invent a DAP, CAN or urea shop price
farmerLine: KAMIS reports crop and some input market figures. It does not replace the bag price at your agrovet. Ask Mkulima will not invent DAP, CAN or urea.
farmerLineSw: KAMIS inaripoti bei za mazao na baadhi ya pembejeo. Haichukui nafasi ya bei ya gunia kwa agrovet yako. Uliza Mkulima hatatengeneza DAP, CAN wala urea.
body: If a Ministry fertilizer quote exists near the farm, say so and label it as reported, not a shop offer. If it does not exist, say it is missing. A listed agrovet is not a verified shop unless verification says so. Save the receipt you actually paid.

title: Tomato leaf spots can match several diseases
farmerLine: Spots, yellowing or wilt on tomato can match more than one problem. A single photo is not a confirmed diagnosis.
farmerLineSw: Madoa, kuwa njano, au kunyauka kwa nyanya kunaweza kufanana na matatizo zaidi ya moja. Picha moja si utambuzi wa hakika.
body: Practical plant-health work compares several plant parts and asks follow-up questions. Photograph the whole plant, both sides of an affected leaf, and the stem. Do not name a definite disease or a spray from one image.

title: Satellite field notes cannot name the cause of a weak patch
farmerLine: A weaker western section on a mapped plot is a reason to walk the field. Satellite data alone cannot say if it is pest, soil, water or something else.
farmerLineSw: Sehemu dhaifu upande wa magharibi wa shamba lililochorwa ni sababu ya kutembea shambani. Data ya setilaiti peke yake haiwezi kusema kama ni wadudu, udongo, maji, au jambo lingine.
body: Earth observation can show that vegetation is stable or uneven across a mapped farm. It must be combined with the farmer's activity and what they see. Ask Mkulima should not dump NDVI numbers or invent a diagnosis.

title: County extension and listed nearby services beat a generic chat plan
farmerLine: For consequential advice, use county extension, a veterinary officer, or a listed service near the farm. A chat plan is not a farm visit.
farmerLineSw: Kwa ushauri mzito, tumia ugani wa kaunti, daktari wa mifugo, au huduma iliyoandikwa karibu na shamba. Mpango wa gumzo si tembeleo la shamba.
body: Ask Mkulima can explain what is on the farmer's record, retrieve published guidance, and point to nearby listed places. It must not pretend to replace extension, a vet, or a PCPB label.

title: Kenya crop planning follows long rains and short rains, which vary by county
farmerLine: Many Kenyan counties plan around long rains and short rains. Exact timing varies by place. Use the forecast for your farm place and what the soil is doing, not a national calendar alone.
farmerLineSw: Kaunti nyingi nchini Kenya hupanga kulingana na mvua za masika na vuli. Muda hususan hutofautiana kwa mahali. Tumia utabiri wa mahali pa shamba na hali ya udongo, si kalenda ya taifa pekee.
body: Kenya Meteorological Department issues seasonal and county forecasts. Farmers should combine the farm-place forecast with soil moisture and their enterprise stage. Ask Mkulima must not invent a planting date for a county without a forecast or field check.

title: Dairy feed quality and water affect milk more than a generic feed tip
farmerLine: Milk responds to forage quality, concentrates you actually feed, and clean water. Keep daily litre records. Ask Mkulima will not invent a feed formula for your herd.
farmerLineSw: Maziwa hutegemea ubora wa majani, chakula unachotoa, na maji safi. Hifadhi lita za kila siku. Uliza Mkulima hatatengeneza fomula ya chakula kwa kundi lako.
body: Practical dairy advice starts from what the farmer feeds and records. Sudden drops in milk need observation of feed, water, heat and animal health. Serious illness needs a veterinary officer.

title: Poultry health starts with clean housing and careful introduction of new birds
farmerLine: Keep housing clean, separate new birds, and watch mortality. Ask Mkulima will not prescribe a vaccine schedule or medicine dose.
farmerLineSw: Weka banda safi, tenga kuku wapya, na angalia vifo. Uliza Mkulima hatatoa ratiba ya chanjo wala kipimo cha dawa.
body: Biosecurity and early observation reduce flock losses. Vaccination and treatment plans belong with a veterinary or animal-health professional who knows the flock and local disease pressure.

title: Coffee payment depends on cherry quality and factory or cooperative rules
farmerLine: Pick ripe cherry, keep deliveries clean, and save what the factory or cooperative paid. Ask Mkulima will not invent a cherry price.
farmerLineSw: Chuma kahawa iliyoiva, weka usafiri safi, na hifadhi malipo ya kiwanda au cooperative. Uliza Mkulima hatatengeneza bei ya cherry.
body: Coffee income depends on harvest timing, quality sorting and the buying centre rules. Record deliveries and deductions. Confirm any price with the cooperative or factory, not from a chat guess.

title: Soil organic matter and drainage matter before adding more fertilizer
farmerLine: Improve soil with compost or manure where you can, and check drainage. Ask Mkulima will not invent a fertilizer rate for your plot.
farmerLineSw: Boresha udongo kwa mbolea ya mimea au samadi unapoweza, na angalia mifereji. Uliza Mkulima hatatengeneza kiasi cha mbolea kwa shamba lako.
body: Soil fertility work in Kenya combines organic matter, drainage and targeted nutrients. A fertilizer rate must match crop, soil and a current product label. Chat must not invent rates.

title: Avocado harvest timing and grade affect what buyers accept
farmerLine: Harvest when fruit is mature for your variety and buyer grade. Confirm rejection reasons with the buyer. Ask Mkulima will not invent an export price.
farmerLineSw: Vuna matunda yakiwa yameiva kwa aina na daraja la mnunuzi. Thibitisha sababu za kukataliwa na mnunuzi. Uliza Mkulima hatatengeneza bei ya kuuza nje.
body: Avocado returns depend on maturity, handling and buyer standards. Keep records of deliveries, grades and rejections. Price claims need a real observation date and source.
